prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp for VEEMAP homepage
Primary request: Design the category-standard "Premium Industrial Integrator" homepage at exceptional craft for VEEMAP Technologies: cinematic factory machinery, proof metrics, capability preview, and a direct requirements enquiry.
Input images: Image 1 is the VEEMAP orange-and-green chevron logo reference; preserve its recognizable geometry in the navigation, cleanly and without redesign.
Scene/backdrop: full-bleed cinematic view inside a modern Indian special-purpose-machine factory, showing a conceptually accurate non-proprietary automated assembly line under controlled industrial lighting.
Subject: a high-speed custom assembly machine with conveyors, precision stations, vision camera, robot pick-and-place, guards, and HMI; premium real-world industrial credibility without revealing any client's proprietary detail.
Style/medium: realistic shippable premium website UI mockup, sophisticated industrial marketing site, not a poster and not standalone concept art.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape desktop first viewport. Transparent dark navigation across the top. The machine is the dominant full-bleed background subject. Strong left-aligned content region with clear primary action. A restrained proof-metric strip and the top edge of a familiar three-capability section appear at the lower fold.
Lighting/mood: cinematic but truthful factory lighting; deep navy shadows, crisp steel highlights, subtle orange task light; confident and precise.
Color palette: near-black #071017, industrial navy #123C59, VEEMAP orange #FF982E, optical white #F4F7F8, small VEEMAP green only in the logo.
Materials/textures: real steel, safety glass, powder-coated machine frames, controlled dark overlay, clean technical grid, no fake glassmorphism.
Text (verbatim): "VEEMAP", "SPECIAL-PURPOSE MACHINES. ENGINEERED AROUND YOUR PROCESS.", "From in-house mechanisms to complete plants.", "TELL US ABOUT YOUR NEEDS", "236 PROJECTS", "55 CLIENTS", "5 SECTORS".

Avoid: generic sci-fi factory; excessive orange glow; bento-card wall; blank abstract hero; stock handshake imagery; unreadable tiny text; generic AI dashboard.
